snippet.title: New Event, Autumn season, Capper and Balance changes | STALZONE
snippet.description:
Start playing STALZONE — https://stalzone.com/start

Word around the Bar is that someone at the Forge managed to blow up one of the generators around the Contor Сenter. Nobody has claimed responsibility, but the factions are looking suspiciously at each other — and at Typhoon, which has been meddling more and more in the affairs of the Zone’s residents.

The explosion didn’t go without consequences.  According to eyewitnesses, a full-blown electrical frenzy has broken out around Forge-11: an anomaly made of pure electricity has appeared above the Control Center, and the sky seems hell-bent on hurling thunder and lightning.

How will this cataclysm end — if it ends at all?

🔎 Follow us on social media:

Discord: https://discord.gg/vexC2RyZ8e
Reddit: https://www.reddit.com/r/stalzone/
